name: type24-part-a-to-geojson-empty
reference: Part A maps no shared key but the derived uid: geometry null, properties empty. geojson writes coordinates [lon, lat], properties in field-line order (callsign, course, speed_ms), then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.
